# Philippa Gordon

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c6 P13](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0013)</sub>
- **Origin:** Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032)</sub>
- **Role:** Student at Redmond College  <sub>[v3 c4 P22](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0022), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Phil  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>; P.G.  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Philippa is a very pretty girl with a vivid, irregular type of prettiness, satin-smooth hair with a gloss as of brown nuts, big brown velvety eyes under oddly-pointed black brows, and a rose-red crooked mouth. She has round cheeks with a soft, ripe glow and wears stylish, modish clothes and hats.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020)_

## Personality

Philippa is a joyful, lighthearted, expressive, and adaptable individual who possesses a loyal, crystal-free soul without snobbishness. She self-admittedly suffers from severe indecision and an inability to keep secrets, yet she has plenty of brains and academic ability. Warm and friendly, she forms quick attachments to others and brings a lively energy into her social interactions.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P21](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0021), [v3 c4 P26](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0026), [v3 c4 P36](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0036), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003)_

## Traits

- Indecisive  <sub>[v3 c4 P26](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0026), [v3 c4 P36](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0036)</sub>
- Loyal  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>

- Fear of being a slave to love or being hurt  <sub>[v3 c4 P54](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0054)</sub>

## Abilities

- Extremely intelligent and academically capable  <sub>[v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003)</sub>

## Goals

- To enjoy college life and be popular among her peers  <sub>[v3 c4 P58](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0058), [v3 c4 P71](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0071)</sub>

## History

Philippa Gordon was raised in Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia, as the daughter of a prominent family. Upon entering Redmond College in Kingsport, she met Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant in Old St. John's Cemetery during her first days of school, quickly declaring her desire to be chummy with them. Her charm and social status granted her access to all Redmond circles, and she brought Anne and Priscilla along into her expanding social life. While at college, she balanced a crowded social life and numerous suitors, including Alec and Alonzo from home, with her academic studies. During her visits home to Mount Holly in Bolingbroke, she hosted continuous social gatherings for her friends.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020), [v3 c4 P24](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0024), [v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032), [v3 c4 P60](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0060), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003), [v3 c21 P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000)_
